title.narrative: Promoting and Protecting Freedom of Religion and Belief (PP-FoRB) EWER Bulletin.

description.narrative: Search is implementing a 36-month project titled: Promoting and Protecting Freedom of Religion and Belief (PP-FoRB) in Nigeria. Funded by the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, the project seeks to address potential conflict issues in relation to religious tolerance and tensions in Nigeria in response to incidents of religious intolerance and religious extremism reported across Nigeria
